py4radiation.data.get_path(table_name)

Get the absolute path to a data file.

Parameters:
table_nameLiteral

Identifier for the Starburst99 available table.

Returns:
str

Absolute path to the data file.

Examples

>>> path = get_path('fig4b')
>>> print(path)
'/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/my_package/data/fig4b.dat'
py4radiation.data.load_table(table_name, **kwargs)

Load one of the available Starburst99 (Leitherer et al. 1999) tables into a numpy array.

Parameters:
table_nameLiteral[‘fig2a’, ‘fig2b’, ‘fig4a’, ‘fig4b’, ‘fig6a’, ‘fig6b’]

Identifier for the Starburst99 available table. Must be one of the specific figure IDs from Leitherer et al. (1999).

**kwargsAny

Additional keyword arguments passed directly to numpy.loadtxt

Returns:
np.NDArray[np.float64]

The data loaded from the file as a numpy array.

Raises:
FileNotFoundError

If the data file is missing from the package installation.

ValueError

If table_name is invalid.

Examples

>>> # Load table fig2a skipping first wavelength row
>>> data = load_table('fig2a', skiprows=1)
>>> data.shape
(1221, 37)
